ज्वल्: ज्वल् JVAL, I.P. (E. also Ā.) jvála, blaze, burn, flame, glow, flash;  be red-hot: pp. jvalita, flaming, blazing, flashing, shining; cs. jvălaya, kindle;  illuminate;  intv. jā-jvalati or jājvalyate, blaze powerfully; shine brilliantly. ud, flare up;  cs. set aflame, kindle;  illuminate. pra, begin to blaze or flash: pp. flaming, blazing;  shining;  cs. kindle. abhi-vi, shine towards. sam, blaze;  cs. -jvāl--aya, kindle.
ज्वल: ज्वल jval-a, m. flame;  -at, pr. pt. burning, shining etc.;  m. burning fire.
ज्वलन: ज्वलन jval-aná, a. burning;  shining;  m. fire;  caustic potash;  n. flaming: -kana, m. spark.
ज्वाल: ज्वाल jvāla, m. flame;  torch;  ā, f. illumination;  flame, bright light: -dhvaja, m. fire, -mukha, m. (Flame-mouth), kind of ghost;  N. of a Brahmarāṣasa, -liṅga, n. N. of a temple of Śiva.
